LESSON: PATHWAY CHOICES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Social Studies and Career Development
Topic 1.1: Pathway Choices

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Pathway Choices
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to learn about career paths?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify factors to consider in the selection of a pathway
2. appreciate the need for choosing a pathway in senior school

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify factors to consider in the selection of a pathway

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify factors to consider in the selection of a pathway.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify factors to consider in the selection of a pathway” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify factors to consider in the selection of a pathway” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify factors to consider in the selection of a pathway" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the need for choosing a pathway in senior school

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the need for choosing a pathway in senior school.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the need for choosing a pathway in senior school” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the need for choosing a pathway in senior school” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the need for choosing a pathway in senior school" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify factors to consider in the selection of a pathway
• Model 2: appreciate the need for choosing a pathway in senior school

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify factors to consider in the selection of a pathway
2. Practise: appreciate the need for choosing a pathway in senior school

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Pathway Choices.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to learn about career paths?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify factors to consider in the selection of a pathway
• appreciate the need for choosing a pathway in senior school

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
